newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's KPB says Oct palm oil price unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's KPB says Oct palm oil price unchanged.

text.p: Indonesia's state-run marketing agency KPB said on Friday it had not increased its local crude palm oil price for October, keeping it at 1,010 rupiah/kg.
"The October allocation price is 1,010 rupiah, the same as September," the official told Reuters.
Traders said KPB had raised its October price to 1,040 rupiah/kg on Thursday but had revised it downwards apparently after several complaints.
"We were told yesterday afternoon by KPB that it will review the price and were later told that the price would stay at 1,010 rupiah," one trader said.
KPB allocates an unspecified amount of crude palm oil each month to local refiners at a discount to market prices to be processed into olein for domestic consumption.
The KPB official declined to comment on market talk that there would be a decline in October allocations due to apparently lower production in some state plantations.
The agency, which markets all crude palm oil produced by state plantations, sells 70 percent of their output locally and exports the rest.
